about: House recipes, batch 04 (helper sA): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Chipotle Honey Pork Ribs
recipes.summary: Slow-baked pork ribs lacquered with chipotle, honey and lime until sticky.
steps: Rub the ribs with the cumin, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Wrap tightly in foil and rest in the fridge for 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 150°C (130°C fan) and bake the foil parcels on a tray for 2 hours 15 minutes, until the meat is very tender.
Mix the chipotle, honey, lime juice and vinegar. Unwrap the ribs, brush with the glaze and roast at 220°C (200°C fan) for 15 minutes, brushing twice, until sticky and 75°C inside.
Rest for 10 minutes, cut between the bones and scatter with coriander before serving.
notes: Food safety: pork ribs must reach at least 70°C; slow-cooked ribs go well beyond that and are tender when the meat pulls from the bone.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Capsicum Egg Rings with Salsa
recipes.summary: Rings of red capsicum with eggs cooked inside, served with salsa and avocado.
steps: Heat the oil in a non-stick frying pan over medium heat and add four capsicum rings.
Crack an egg into each ring and sprinkle with cumin and salt.
Cover and cook for 5 minutes, until the whites are set and the capsicum has softened.
Lift onto plates and serve with the salsa, avocado and coriander on the side.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Prawn and Black Bean Burrito Bowls
recipes.summary: Chilli-lime prawns over rice with black beans, corn, avocado and crunchy lettuce.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, then drain and stir through half the lime juice and half the coriander.
Toss the prawns in the taco seasoning and cook in the oil for 4 minutes, until pink, curled and opaque.
Warm the beans and corn for 4 minutes, until hot.
Build bowls of rice, lettuce, beans, corn, prawns and avocado and top with salsa, the remaining lime juice and coriander.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through.
Gluten-free: check the seasoning label. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Baked Chicken Flautas
recipes.summary: Rolled corn tortillas filled with shredded chicken and cheese, baked until crisp.
steps: Poach the chicken in simmering water for 18 minutes, until it reaches 75°C, then shred and mix with the chipotle, cheese and 1/4 cup salsa.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds each side, until pliable.
Fill each tortilla with chicken, roll tightly and set seam-side down on a lined tray. Brush with oil.
Bake for 20 minutes, until golden and crisp. Serve with sour cream, avocado, coriander and the remaining salsa.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C right through before shredding; the flautas should be steaming hot.
Gluten-free: check the tortilla label.

recipes.title: Loaded Chilli Beef Corn Chip Bake
recipes.summary: Corn chips layered with beany chilli beef, melted cheese and fresh toppings.
steps: Cook the onion in a pan for 5 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and mince and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Stir in the seasoning, tomatoes and beans and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Layer the chips, chilli and cheese in a large dish and bake for 10 minutes, until the cheese is melted and bubbling.
Top with sour cream, avocado and coriander and serve straight away.
notes: Food safety: the beef mince must reach 75°C right through before baking.
Gluten-free: check the chips and seasoning labels.

recipes.title: Sweet Potato, Chorizo and Egg Breakfast Bowls
recipes.summary: Roasted sweet potato and chorizo with soft eggs, lime and avocado.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the sweet potato, chorizo, onion, oil and paprika on a large tray.
Roast for 25 minutes, turning once, until the potato is tender and the chorizo is crisp.
Fry or poach the eggs for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Divide the sweet potato and chorizo between bowls and top with the eggs, avocado, coriander and lime wedges.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Citrus Pollo Asado with Charred Corn
recipes.summary: Spatchcock chicken marinated in orange, lime and garlic and roasted with corn on the cob.
steps: Mix the juices, garlic, cumin, oregano, paprika, oil and 2 teaspoons of salt. Coat the chicken and marinate for at least 4 hours.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Sit the chicken skin-side up on a tray and roast for 30 minutes.
Add the corn to the tray and roast for 25 minutes, until the thigh reaches 75°C and the corn is tender and charred.
Rest for 10 minutes, carve and scatter with coriander.
notes: Food safety: whole chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part of the thigh; discard any raw marinade.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Spatchcock Chicken with Parsley and Garlic
recipes.summary: Butterflied chicken roasted over potatoes with a punchy parsley and garlic dressing.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Rub the chicken with 2 tablespoons of oil, paprika and salt. Toss the potato in the remaining oil on a large tray.
Set the chicken over the potato and roast for 50 minutes, until the skin is golden and the thigh reaches 75°C.
Mix the parsley, garlic, vinegar, the 1/3 cup oil and chilli flakes for the dressing.
Rest the chicken for 10 minutes, carve and serve with the potato and plenty of dressing.
notes: Food safety: whole chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part of the thigh, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Ecuadorian-Style Coconut Prawn Stew
recipes.summary: Prawns simmered in a coconut, tomato and peanut broth with coriander and lime.
steps: Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft, then add the garlic and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, coconut milk and peanut butter and simmer for 10 minutes, until thick and creamy.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Add the prawns to the stew and cook for 4 minutes, until pink and opaque. Stir through the lime and coriander and serve over the rice.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque all the way through. Contains peanuts and shellfish.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Humita-Style Corn Bake
recipes.summary: A creamy, sweet corn and basil bake with melted mozzarella.
steps: Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Cook the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, until soft.
Blend three-quarters of the corn with the milk, eggs, polenta and basil until coarse, then stir in the remaining corn and the onion.
Pour into a greased baking dish, scatter with mozzarella and paprika.
Bake for 35 minutes, until set in the centre and golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before serving.
notes: Food safety: the bake contains raw egg and must be set in the centre.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Olive and Capsicum Chicken Pot Rice, Dominican-Style
recipes.summary: Seasoned chicken and rice cooked with olives, capsicum and tomato in one pot.
steps: Brown the chicken in the oil in a wide pot for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out. Cook the onion and capsicum for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, oregano and paste.
Stir in the rice, stock and olives, bring to a simmer until bubbling and nestle the chicken on top.
Cover and cook on low for 25 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 75°C. Stir through the peas for 3 minutes.
Rest for 5 minutes, then scatter with coriander and serve.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; cool and refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Estrogonofe de Carne with Rice
recipes.summary: Tender beef and mushrooms in a creamy tomato sauce, served over rice.
steps: Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Sear the beef in the oil in two batches for 2 minutes each, until browned, and lift out. Cook the onion and mushrooms for 8 minutes, until golden.
Add the garlic, paste and wine and boil for 2 minutes. Stir in the cream and mustard and simmer for 4 minutes, until slightly thick.
Return the beef for 2 minutes until hot, with the centre at least 63°C, and serve over the rice with parsley.
notes: Food safety: beef strips are safe once browned and hot through; the centre should reach at least 63°C.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Moroccan Chicken Bastilla Pie
recipes.summary: Layers of crisp filo around spiced shredded chicken, almonds and egg, dusted with cinnamon sugar.
steps: Simmer the chicken, onion, garlic, ginger, 1/2 teaspoon of cinnamon, saffron and 1 cup water for 35 minutes, until the chicken reaches 75°C. Shred it, boil the liquid down to 1/2 cup and stir in the beaten eggs over low heat for 4 minutes, until scrambled and set.
Mix the chicken with the herbs, egg mixture and half the almonds.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Layer six brushed filo sheets in a round tin, overhanging the edge, pile in the filling, fold over and cover with six more brushed sheets.
Bake for 35 minutes, until deep golden. Dust with icing sugar, the remaining almonds and cinnamon.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C right through and the egg mixture be fully set before baking.
Contains nuts, gluten, milk and egg.

recipes.title: Lamb and Chickpea Couscous with Harissa
recipes.summary: Tender spiced lamb and chickpeas ladled over fluffy couscous, with harissa on the side.
steps: Brown the lamb in the oil in a heavy pot for 8 minutes, until golden. Add the onion, garlic and spices for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes, stock and carrot, cover and simmer for 1 hour, until the lamb is tender.
Add the chickpeas and simmer for 15 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Soak the couscous in 2 cups boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff and serve with the lamb, harissa and coriander.
notes: Food safety: lamb is safe at 63°C; this braise cooks well beyond that and should be steaming hot.
Contains gluten (couscous).

recipes.title: Maakouda-Style Potato Omelette
recipes.summary: A thick, spiced potato and herb omelette, cooked until golden on both sides.
steps: Mix the potato with the garlic, cumin, paprika and herbs and season.
Beat in the eggs until the mixture is just combined.
Heat the oil in a 24cm non-stick pan and pour in the mix. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes, until set around the edges, then flip with a plate and cook for 8 minutes, until golden and set through.
Cut into wedges and serve warm with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Roast Cauliflower Tagine with Green Olives
recipes.summary: Roast cauliflower and carrots simmered in a ginger and saffron tagine sauce with olives.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the cauliflower and carrot with 2 tablespoons of oil and roast for 25 minutes, until golden.
Cook the onion in the remaining oil for 5 minutes, then the garlic and spices for 1 minute. Add the tomatoes and stock and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the roast vegetables, olives and preserved lemon and simmer for 10 minutes, until tender and the sauce is thick.
Scatter with coriander and serve with couscous or bread.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Charred Fish Kebabs with Lemon and Cumin
recipes.summary: White fish chunks marinated in cumin, paprika and lemon, grilled on skewers.
steps: Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, cumin, paprika and coriander, add the fish and marinate for 30 minutes.
Thread the fish onto skewers with the onion and capsicum.
Grill for 8 minutes, turning, until the fish is opaque and flakes and the vegetables are charred.
Soak the couscous in 2 cups boiling water for 5 minutes, fluff and serve with the kebabs.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and it flakes with a fork.

recipes.title: Moroccan Orange and Honey Chicken
recipes.summary: Chicken roasted in an orange, honey and cinnamon glaze over fragrant rice.
steps: Mix the orange juice, honey, cinnamon, ginger, garlic and oil, coat the chicken and marinate for 1 hour.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Arrange the chicken and onion in a roasting dish and pour over the marinade.
Roast for 45 minutes, basting twice, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the glaze is sticky. Scatter with almonds for the last 5 minutes.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and serve with the chicken, juices and coriander.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; the glaze should be boiled in the oven, not served raw.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Lebanese Beef Kafta Tray Bake
recipes.summary: Spiced beef kafta baked on potato and tomato until the juices run into the vegetables.
steps: Mix the mince, onion, parsley, allspice, cinnamon, cumin and salt and press into a thin layer in a baking dish.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Cut the kafta into squares, then layer over the potato and tomato slices, tucked between the pieces.
Whisk the stock and tomato paste and pour over. Drizzle with oil, scatter with pine nuts and cover with foil.
Bake for 30 minutes, uncover and bake for 20 minutes, until golden, the potatoes are tender and the beef reaches 75°C.
notes: Food safety: beef mince must reach 75°C right through, with no pink.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Lebanese Spiced Rice with Chicken and Almonds
recipes.summary: Cinnamon-scented rice with shredded chicken, toasted almonds and parsley.
steps: Simmer the chicken in the stock for 25 minutes, until it reaches 75°C. Lift out, shred it and keep the stock.
Cook the onion in the butter for 5 minutes, add the spices and rice and stir for 1 minute, then pour in 3 cups of the hot stock.
Cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, until the rice is tender. Rest for 5 minutes.
Fluff the rice, top with chicken, almonds, pine nuts and parsley and serve with yoghurt.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C right through before shredding; refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Cilbir Poached Eggs with Chilli Butter
recipes.summary: Poached eggs on garlicky yoghurt with sizzling paprika butter and dill.
steps: Stir the yoghurt and garlic with a pinch of salt and spread on two plates.
Poach the eggs in barely simmering water with the vinegar for 3 minutes, until the whites are set and the yolks soft.
Melt the butter until foaming, then stir in the paprika and chilli for 30 seconds.
Set the eggs on the yoghurt, spoon over the butter and scatter with dill. Serve with toasted sourdough.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Whole Roast Cauliflower with Tahini and Pomegranate
recipes.summary: A whole cauliflower roasted until golden, dressed in lemon tahini with pomegranate and herbs.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Rub the cauliflower with 2 tablespoons of oil, the cumin, paprika and salt and roast with the chickpeas alongside for 55 minutes, until deeply golden and tender when pierced.
Whisk the tahini, lemon juice, garlic and 1/4 cup water until smooth.
Set the cauliflower on a platter and spoon over the tahini.
Scatter with chickpeas, pomegranate, parsley and pistachios, and cut into wedges to serve.
notes: Vegan. Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Lebanese Fish and Rice Sayadieh
recipes.summary: Spiced rice with caramelised onion and golden fish, topped with toasted pine nuts.
steps: Season the fish with the cumin, turmeric and salt and fry in 2 tablespoons of oil for 3 minutes per side, until golden and flaking. Lift out.
Cook the onions in the remaining oil for 25 minutes, until very dark and sweet. Lift out half and keep for the top.
Stir the rice and cinnamon into the pot, add the stock, cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, until the rice is tender.
Fold in the fish gently and top with the reserved onions, pine nuts and lemon.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes with a fork; refrigerate leftover rice within 1 hour.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Za'atar Chicken Traybake with Chickpeas
recipes.summary: Za'atar-coated chicken roasted over chickpeas, red onion and lemon.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Toss the chickpeas, onion, lemon and garlic with half the oil in a large tray.
Rub the chicken with the za'atar, remaining oil and salt and set on top.
Roast for 45 minutes, until the chicken is golden and reaches 75°C and the chickpeas are crisp at the edges.
Serve with yoghurt and parsley.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Halloumi and Egg Breakfast Wraps
recipes.summary: Flatbread wraps with golden halloumi, scrambled eggs, tomato and mint.
steps: Fry the halloumi in a dry pan for 2 minutes each side, until golden. Lift out.
Scramble the eggs in the oil for 3 minutes, until just set.
Warm the flatbread and spread with hummus.
Fill with halloumi, eggs, tomato, cucumber and mint, then roll up and serve.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Caribbean Spiced Pork Chops with Mango Salsa
recipes.summary: Allspice and thyme pork loin steaks served with a fresh mango and lime salsa.
steps: Rub the pork with the allspice, thyme, sugar and salt.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Sear the pork in the oil for 5 minutes each side, until browned and the centre reaches 70°C. Rest for 5 minutes.
Mix the mango, onion, lime juice, coriander and chilli and serve over the pork with the rice.
notes: Food safety: pork steaks must reach 70°C in the centre, then rest.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Escovitch Fish with Pickled Vegetables
recipes.summary: Crisp fried fish topped with a tangy pickled onion, carrot and chilli dressing.
steps: Simmer the vinegar, allspice, sugar, 1/4 cup water and a pinch of salt for 3 minutes, then pour over the onion, carrot, capsicum and scotch bonnet and leave to pickle.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Dust the fish in cornflour and shallow-fry in the oil for 4 minutes each side, until golden, crisp and flaking.
Spoon the pickled vegetables and some of their liquid over the hot fish and serve with rice.
notes: Food safety: fish is cooked when opaque and flakes with a fork.
Gluten-free if you use cornflour labelled gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Trinidad-Style Potato and Chickpea Roti Wraps
recipes.summary: Warm roti wrapped around curried potato and chickpeas with a squeeze of lime.
steps: Cook the onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, curry powder and cumin for 1 minute.
Add the potato and water and simmer for 12 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Add the chickpeas and mash roughly, cooking for 5 minutes, until thick.
Warm the roti, fill with the curry and coriander, roll up and serve with lime.
notes: Vegan.

recipes.title: Jerk Lamb Cutlets with Pineapple Rice
recipes.summary: Jerk-spiced lamb cutlets over rice with sweet charred pineapple.
steps: Mix 1 tablespoon of oil, the allspice, thyme, cinnamon, chilli, garlic and soy sauce and coat the lamb. Marinate for 1 hour.
Cook the rice in boiling water for 12 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Sear the cutlets in a hot pan for 3 minutes each side for medium, until browned. Rest for 5 minutes.
Char the pineapple in the remaining oil for 3 minutes, until caramelised, and toss through the rice with the spring onion. Serve with the cutlets.
notes: Food safety: lamb cutlets are safe seared; the centre reaches 63°C for medium and 71°C for well done.
Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Potato and Ricotta Pierogi with Buttered Onions
recipes.summary: Pillowy dumplings of potato and ricotta, boiled, then pan-fried with butter and onion.
steps: Knead the flour, egg, water, 1 tablespoon sour cream and a pinch of salt for 5 minutes, until smooth. Rest for 30 minutes.
Cook half the onion in 1 tablespoon of butter for 8 minutes, until golden, and mix with the potato, ricotta and seasoning.
Roll the dough thin, cut 8cm rounds, fill, fold into half-moons and pinch to seal.
Boil in batches for 4 minutes, until they float. Fry in the remaining butter and onion for 4 minutes, until golden. Serve with sour cream and chives.
notes: Food safety: the dumpling dough contains raw egg: boil until the dumplings float and are cooked through.
Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Polish Meatballs in Dill Cream Sauce
recipes.summary: Tender pork and beef meatballs in a creamy dill sauce, served over mashed potato.
steps: Mix the minces, onion, egg, breadcrumbs and salt and roll into 20 balls.
Brown the meatballs in the oil for 8 minutes, until golden, and lift out.
Melt the butter, stir in the flour for 1 minute, whisk in the stock and simmer for 5 minutes. Return the meatballs and cook for 10 minutes, until cooked through and 75°C in the middle.
Stir in the sour cream and dill and serve over the mash.
notes: Food safety: meatballs must reach 75°C right through, with no pink.

recipes.title: Czech Garlic Potato Pancakes with Bacon
recipes.summary: Crisp grated potato pancakes with garlic and marjoram, served with crisp bacon.
steps: Squeeze the grated potato in a tea towel to remove the liquid. Mix with the garlic, marjoram, eggs, starch and salt.
Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry spoonfuls, flattened, for 4 minutes per side, until deeply golden and crisp.
Fry the bacon in a separate pan for 6 minutes, until crisp.
Serve the pancakes with bacon and sour cream.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Rakott Krumpli Layered Potato Bake
recipes.summary: Hungarian layers of potato, boiled egg and smoked sausage under sour cream.
steps: Hard-boil the eggs for 10 minutes, until firm, then cool, peel and slice.
Heat the oven to 190°C (170°C fan). Butter a baking dish and layer potato, egg, sausage and seasoning, repeating twice.
Mix the sour cream and milk, pour over and sprinkle with paprika.
Bake for 35 minutes, until bubbling and golden. Scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: hard-boil the eggs until firm; the sausage should be steaming hot (75°C) all the way through.
Gluten-free if you use a sausage labelled gluten-free.

recipes.title: Caraway Roast Chicken with Braised Cabbage
recipes.summary: Roast chicken scented with caraway and paprika over sweet braised cabbage.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Rub the chicken with the caraway, paprika, 1 tablespoon of butter and salt.
Cook the onion, cabbage and apple in the remaining butter in a roasting dish for 8 minutes, until starting to wilt, then add the stock and vinegar.
Sit the chicken on the cabbage and roast for 1 hour 15 minutes, until the thigh reaches 75°C and the cabbage is tender.
Rest for 15 minutes, then carve and serve with the cabbage and juices.
notes: Food safety: whole chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part of the thigh, with clear juices.
Gluten-free.

recipes.title: Bacon and Caraway Onion Tart, German-Style
recipes.summary: A crisp pastry tart with soft onions, bacon, caraway and a creamy egg custard.
steps: Cook the onion and bacon in the butter for 20 minutes, until very soft and golden. Cool.
Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Line a tart tin with the pastry and prick the base.
Whisk the eggs, sour cream, caraway, nutmeg and salt, stir in the onions and pour into the tin.
Bake for 35 minutes, until the custard is set and the pastry is deep golden.
notes: Food safety: the custard has raw egg and must be fully set in the centre.

recipes.title: Krautfleckerl Cabbage and Noodle Pan
recipes.summary: Caramelised cabbage tossed with egg pasta and caraway.
steps: Cook the sugar in the butter for 2 minutes, until golden, add the onion and cabbage and cook for 20 minutes, stirring, until deeply golden and soft.
Add the caraway and vinegar and season.
Cook the pasta in salted boiling water for 10 minutes, until tender, and drain.
Toss the pasta through the cabbage with the sour cream and parsley.
notes: Vegetarian.

recipes.title: Parsley and Lemon Salmon Fishcakes
recipes.summary: Crisp pan-fried salmon and potato cakes with parsley and lemon, served with peas.
steps: Mix the salmon, potato, parsley, lemon zest and mustard and shape into eight patties. Chill for 20 minutes.
Dip in beaten egg and coat in breadcrumbs.
Fry the cakes in the oil for 4 minutes per side, until golden and hot all the way through.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes, until tender, and serve with the fishcakes.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flakes; the cakes should be steaming hot in the middle.

recipes.title: Sausage and Egg English Muffin Stacks
recipes.summary: English muffins layered with a herby sausage patty, fried egg and melted cheese.

items: 400g pork sausage, meat squeezed from skins

steps: Mix the sausage meat with the sage and shape into four patties.
Fry the patties for 10 minutes, turning, until browned and 75°C in the centre.
Toast the muffins and fry the eggs in the butter for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Stack each muffin with a patty, cheese and egg.
notes: Food safety: sausage patties must reach 75°C with no pink; cook the eggs until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Chicken and Waffles with Maple Butter
recipes.summary: Crisp oven-fried chicken thighs on fluffy waffles with maple butter.
steps: Marinate the chicken in half the buttermilk and salt for 2 hours. Mix the plain flour, paprika and garlic powder and coat the chicken.
Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the chicken in the oil on a tray and bake for 35 minutes, turning once, until crisp and 75°C inside.
Whisk the self-raising flour, eggs, milk and the remaining buttermilk and cook in a waffle iron until golden and crisp.
Melt the butter and maple syrup together and serve the chicken on the waffles with the maple butter.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part; discard the raw chicken marinade.

recipes.title: Pan-Fried Salmon Cakes with Lemon Mayo
recipes.summary: Pan-fried salmon cakes with a lemon mayonnaise and a crisp cabbage slaw.
steps: Mix the salmon, half the breadcrumbs, the egg, 2 tablespoons of mayonnaise, mustard and spring onion and shape into eight cakes.
Coat in the remaining breadcrumbs.
Fry the cakes in the oil for 4 minutes per side, until golden and hot all the way through.
Stir the lemon zest and juice into the remaining mayonnaise and serve with the cakes and slaw.
notes: Food safety: salmon is cooked when opaque and flakes; the cakes should be steaming hot in the middle.

recipes.title: Prawn, Corn and Potato Boil
recipes.summary: A one-pot boil of prawns, corn, potatoes and sausage with a spicy seasoning.
steps: Bring a large pot of water to the boil with the cajun seasoning, lemon and half the garlic. Add the potatoes and cook for 12 minutes, until almost tender.
Add the sausage and corn and cook for 6 minutes.
Add the prawns and cook for 3 minutes, until pink and opaque. Drain.
Melt the butter with the remaining garlic until foaming, toss it through the boil and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: prawns are cooked when pink, curled and opaque; the sausage must be steaming hot.
Gluten-free: check the seasoning and sausage labels.

recipes.title: Cannellini and Sweet Corn Turkey Chilli
recipes.summary: A mild, hearty chilli of turkey mince, white beans and sweet corn.
steps: Cook the onion and capsicum in the oil for 6 minutes, until soft. Add the garlic and spices for 1 minute.
Add the turkey mince and cook for 8 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Add the beans, tomatoes, stock and corn and simmer for 25 minutes, until thick.
Scatter with coriander and serve with the toppings of your choice.
notes: Food safety: turkey mince must reach 75°C right through, with no pink.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Chicken Parmigiana with Crisp Potato Wedges
recipes.summary: A crumbed chicken schnitzel under tomato sauce and melted cheese, with golden wedges.
steps: Heat the oven to 220°C (200°C fan). Toss the potato in the olive oil and roast for 35 minutes, until golden.
Flatten the chicken to 1.5cm, coat in flour, egg and panko, then fry in the oil for 3 minutes per side, until golden.
Simmer the passata, garlic and oregano for 5 minutes. Set the chicken on a tray, top with sauce, mozzarella and parmesan.
Bake for 15 minutes, until the cheese is golden and the chicken reaches 75°C. Serve with the wedges.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part.

recipes.title: Snag Breakfast Rolls with Onion and Tomato Sauce
recipes.summary: Soft rolls filled with grilled sausage, caramelised onion, fried egg and tomato sauce.
steps: Cook the sausages in the oil in a pan for 15 minutes, turning, until browned and 75°C inside.
Cook the onion in the same pan for 10 minutes, until soft and golden.
Fry the eggs in the butter for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Split the rolls and fill with sausages, onion, egg and tomato sauce.
notes: Food safety: sausages must reach 75°C with no pink; cook eggs until the whites are set.

recipes.title: Sticky Lemon-Garlic Chicken Bake, Greek-Style
recipes.summary: Chicken thighs roasted with potatoes in lemon, garlic and oregano until sticky and golden.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C (180°C fan). Mix the oil, lemon juice, garlic, oregano and salt in a roasting dish and toss the chicken and potato through.
Pour the stock around, and roast for 55 minutes, turning once, until the chicken reaches 75°C and the potatoes are golden.
Rest for 5 minutes, spooning the pan juices over the potatoes.
Scatter with parsley and serve.
notes: Food safety: chicken must reach 75°C in the thickest part, with clear juices.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Huevos Rotos-Style Eggs on Crisp Potatoes
recipes.summary: Fried eggs broken over crisp potatoes and cured ham, Spanish tavern-style.
steps: Fry the potato in the oil in a large pan for 15 minutes, turning, until golden, crisp and tender. Season with salt.
Move the potato to the side and fry the eggs for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Break the yolks over the potato and add the torn ham.
Dust with paprika and scatter with parsley.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until the whites are set; serve firm yolks to young children, older people or anyone pregnant.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Provencal Lamb Shoulder with White Beans
recipes.summary: Lamb shoulder roasted slowly with herbes de Provence, garlic and white beans.
steps: Make slits in the lamb and push in the garlic. Rub with the oil, herbs, lemon juice and salt and rest for 2 hours.
Heat the oven to 160°C (140°C fan). Sit the lamb on the onion in a deep tray with the tomatoes and stock, cover with foil and roast for 3 hours 15 minutes, until very tender.
Add the beans around the lamb, uncover and roast for 30 minutes, until the lamb is browned and reaches 90°C.
Rest for 15 minutes, scatter with parsley and serve with the beans and juices.
notes: Food safety: lamb shoulder is safe at 63°C; this slow roast reaches 90°C and pulls apart.
Gluten-free. Dairy-free.

recipes.title: Sicilian-Style Eggplant and Ricotta Bake
recipes.summary: Pasta baked with fried eggplant, tomato, basil and ricotta salata-style feta.
steps: Fry the eggplant in the oil in batches for 8 minutes, until deeply golden, and drain.
Cook the onion for 5 minutes, add the garlic and tomatoes and simmer for 15 minutes, until thick.
Cook the penne in salted boiling water for 8 minutes, until just short of tender, drain and mix with the sauce, eggplant and basil.
Spoon into a dish, dot with ricotta, top with mozzarella and bake at 200°C (180°C fan) for 20 minutes, until golden and bubbling.
notes: Vegetarian.
